visualCharacteristics.summary: Container-width image-only promo slider with dot indicators
visualCharacteristics.layout: One image per view at container width, dot indicators below, arrows on hover/focus, autoplays (5s) with a pause button

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: banner image (optional second image = mobile image); cell 2 (optional): link to the promotion (bare URL or labelled link; the whole banner links). Any other text is shown as a caption
contentPattern.source: 4 image-only linked slides (Mag by Titan, Edge Titanium, Wedding, Nebula x Tarun Tahiliani)

usage: Rotating image-only promo banners inside the page content width.
reuseGuidance: Use for image-only promos. For a full-bleed hero with labelled indicators use carousel-hero.
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
